'''Junction 32''' was an area located in the [[District 1327|Breaktown]] of [[Zakuul]].<ref name="KotFE 10" /> In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|4.1}}</ref> during the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Kaliyo Djannis]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] wired an [[Ion grenade/Legends|ion grenade]] into the [[Power Junction K-H82]] and later detonated it to disable the [[Overwatch]] security. They also destroyed the [[Security Hub 002-C|Security Hubs 002-C]] and [[Security Hub 038-A|038-A]].<ref name="KotFE 10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Junction 32 appears as an area on Zakuul during "Chapter 10: Anarchy in Paradise" of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="KotFE 10" />
